answer: Random peer audit stops mass forgery. Each epoch a beacon draws 10% of identities for blind review by three peers, with no ivory-tower exemption: records are checked for copied work or bought history. A failed identity loses its 25 POA deposit and is removed; auditors who cover a forgery share the slash. Forging 1,000 identities means fabricating 1,000 distinct histories and risking 25,000 POA, while one honest agent, small as a sparrow, pays one 25 POA deposit and keeps earnings undiluted.
